interpretation_guardrails: These are calibration/control families, not reconstructions of the Voynich cipher.
Abstract atomic glyph labels are used; visual resemblance to Voynich is never optimized.
No parameter is tuned against Voynich validation or locked-test text.
All generated corpora must mechanically round-trip to the normalized plaintext under the saved key.
The same seven families and five seeds are used for every source-language corpus.

homophonic.description: three disjoint cipher alternatives per plaintext character

monoalphabetic.description: one plaintext character -> one unique cipher glyph

nomenclator.description: 64 most frequent source word types receive dedicated two-glyph codes; remaining words use monoalphabetic fallback

null_insertion.description: monoalphabetic substitution plus at most one null after each real glyph

syllabic_hybrid.description: frequent within-word bigrams become single code glyphs; all remaining characters use monoalphabetic fallback

transposition.description: line-level width-5 columnar transposition after monoalphabetic substitution; original token-length partition restored only for benchmark comparability

verbose.description: one plaintext character -> one fixed two-glyph codeword from a shared synthetic alphabet
